title: Aaj hum bachche!
format: Kitty Gang role-reversal on the Children's Day game: the gang plays Housie like school kids, fighting over the Water Bottle, Teddy Bear and Tiffin Box groups

experiment.hook: Myra hopping like a schoolgirl on the Children's Day home art, heartbeat at 0 s, mascot ball spinning above, chip 'AAJ HUM BACHCHE!' pinned from the first frame, she says 'Bal Diwas hai! Aaj hum bachche!'
experiment.variable: length: the shortest theme reel yet, 7 quick shots and about 15 s before the ending (others ran 20 to 30 s), so the payoff lands before people drift
experiment.hypothesis: the middle is our weak spot (watched % 9 to 18), so a reel half as long should hold more of it: watched % above 22 (best 18), skip under 55% (best 50.3), at least 1 share from moms who remember tiffin fights

idea: On Children's Day the gang behaves like school kids at Housie: Tanya guards her Water Bottle, Ruhi needs one number for Teddy Bear, 14 is called and she wins, then Myra finds her Tiffin Box empty and Shruti is caught chewing.
beats: hook: aaj hum bachche / esc 1: Tanya, meri Water Bottle / esc 2: Ruhi, Teddy Bear ek number baaki / call 14, Teddy Bear done / turn: Ruhi brags / button: Myra, mera tiffin kisne khaaya? Shruti chewing
caption: Bal Diwas pe har mummy phir se bachchi! Tiffin wali saheli ko tag karo. Aaj ki {theme} Housie mein Teddy Bear kiska?

lines.text: Bal Diwas hai! Aaj hum bachche!
lines.say: बाल दिवस है! आज हम बच्चे!

lines.text: Meri Water Bottle! Kisi ko nahi!
lines.say: मेरी वॉटर बॉटल! किसी को नहीं!

lines.text: Teddy meri! Tum sab dekhte raho!
lines.say: टेडी मेरी! तुम सब देखते रहो!

lines.text: Housie mein bhookh lagti hai na.
lines.say: हाउज़ी में भूख लगती है ना।
